report.scope: Complete repeated solves with ordinary formatted output or a shared external checksum consumer. The sink removes output-list construction and formatting in fwp, and formatting in C/Rust, but adds checksum work. This difference is not pure output time or pure arithmetic time. Arithmetic, input creation, update buffers, bounds checks and cleanup remain. No LTO; the same separately compiled C consumer reads every result coordinate. Compilation, dump validation, memory profiles and RSS probes are excluded from timed samples. C/Rust reuse two numerical buffers; fwp constructs immutable arrays. Memory profiles cover fwp managed/raw storage and only the numerical buffers in C/Rust; those scopes are not directly comparable. Process RSS covers each complete process. One run does not establish a compiler speed improvement.

hosts.scope: Independent inspection of 109 measurement/control executables and 60 untimed native controls. Timing conclusions require separate control and repeated-run analysis.

report.scope: Complete repeated solves with ordinary formatted output or a shared external checksum consumer. The sink removes output-list construction and formatting in fwp, and formatting in C/Rust, but adds checksum work. This difference is not pure output time or pure arithmetic time. Arithmetic, input creation, update buffers, bounds checks and cleanup remain. No LTO; the same separately compiled C consumer reads every result coordinate. Compilation, dump validation, memory profiles and RSS probes are excluded from timed samples. C/Rust reuse two numerical buffers; fwp constructs immutable arrays. Memory profiles cover fwp managed/raw storage and only the numerical buffers in C/Rust; those scopes are not directly comparable. Process RSS covers each complete process. One run does not establish a compiler speed improvement.

hosts.scope: Independent inspection of 109 measurement/control executables and 60 untimed native controls. Timing conclusions require separate control and repeated-run analysis.
